About Helvorxy

Helvorxy is an independent software studio. We build small iPhone and iPad apps, each designed around a single practical job instead of an ever-growing feature list.

Every app ships with the same commitments: a clear interface, no account requirement where one isn't needed, and no data collection beyond what the app genuinely uses.
